current.note: 368 artifacts by review state (Waiting, Accepted, To revise); kinds as a filter; no renewal for most, no control readiness

changes.title: Status is what the evidence owes
changes.text: The Status column reads the lifecycle: Needs artifact, Needs renewal, Upcoming renewal, Ready, in that order. Error rows (a rejected automated run) wait behind one line over the table and its Show them.
changes.drata: Evidence carries five statuses, driven by its renewal date and artifact; Error counts neither way.

changes.title: Four plain tiles that filter
changes.text: Needs artifact 108, Needs renewal 37, Upcoming renewal 16, Ready 195. Only the two problem tiles lead with the warning glyph; choosing a tile filters the list, choosing it again clears it.
changes.drata: Plain stat tiles over a register, a big ink number under a label; a problem tile carries a glyph.

changes.title: A renewal date for every artifact
changes.text: Collected date plus its controls' assessment frequency (every 30 days, quarterly or annually). A past date says so in red words: "Oct 13 · 35 days past due".
changes.drata: Each evidence has a renewal date and schedule; Upcoming renewal starts two months before it.

changes.title: Controls as k of n ready
changes.text: One compact mark per row: a dot per control in its status tone, then "1 of 2 ready". The evidence owner has its own column, apart from any control's owner.
changes.drata: An evidence row counts its Ready and Not ready controls; the evidence owner is separate from the control owner.

changes.title: Source says how it arrives
changes.text: File, Link, Scan import or Ticket, as a filter and a column. A scan import carries the sync mark: its versions are fixed.
changes.drata: Source is File, URL, Ticket or Test; test evidence comes from the test itself.

changes.title: A preview you walk through
changes.text: The eye opens a drawer with "4 of 368", Previous and Next walking the filtered list, the status, the facts, linked controls, versions and renewal, and Open.
changes.drata: A record's preview drawer shows "2 of 10" with Previous and Next, the status and Open.

changes.title: Import sits in More
changes.text: More › Import evidence from a spreadsheet opens the import flow; Add evidence stays the one primary.
changes.drata: Create evidence offers Bulk import, Import evidence from CSV.

changes.title: STIG checklists join the list
changes.text: V3's seven STIG checklists are rows of the register, Source STIG checklist, each with its run date and renewal; a saved view lists them, and the drawer shows their open rules by CAT.
changes.drata: Evidence collected by a connection sits in the one library beside uploaded files, marked by where it came from.

current.note: Review state in the header, Cited by and versions; no renewal date, no control readiness

changes.title: The one next step: Renew
changes.text: "Past renewal by 26 days: collected Sep 22, renew every 30 days" with Renew. Loud in words, on a white card, not a tinted banner. With no artifact it says so and offers Add new artifact.
changes.drata: A pale red banner, "This evidence needs an artifact", with a filled Add new artifact.

changes.title: Linked controls as status chips
changes.text: SI-6(3) and SI-7(1) as code chips in their status tone, each with its status, the requirement that cites it and objectives evidenced (0 of 2, 3 of 3); "1 of 2 ready" and Link controls.
changes.drata: Linked controls card with Link Controls; each control a code chip in its status colour.

changes.title: Renewal says when and why
changes.text: Schedule every 30 days; why: SI-7(1)'s assessment frequency; the parameter that would set it (CA-07_ODP[02], not set); renew by; upcoming from.
changes.drata: Creation and renewal dates and a renewal schedule drive the status.

changes.title: One header with facts
changes.text: Trail, title, ⋯ then Link controls; a facts strip: Status, Renewal date, Source, Evidence owner (with a pencil), Collected, Controls.
changes.drata: Facts row: status chip, evidence owner, source; ⋯ at top right.

changes.title: A sunken body with cards
changes.text: The body sits in the grey well: Linked controls and Versions on the left, Renewal and Details (its own Edit for the owner) on the right.
changes.drata: White chrome, the record body in a grey well holding white bordered cards.

changes.title: One store for every link
changes.text: Link controls here, in the picker or on the Drata control record, and it is one link: the control record's evidence and the renewal check read the same store, and a renewal here lowers the check's count.
changes.drata: Evidence and controls are linked once and shown from both sides.

current.note: A scan's log extract reads like any uploaded file: one version, editable, deletable

changes.title: Each run is a fixed version
changes.text: Audit log collection's monthly runs (Sep 13, Aug 14, Jul 15) list as versions marked Fixed, with no Remove and no Delete evidence.
changes.drata: Every automated run writes an event that is itself evidence; test evidence can't be deleted.

changes.title: Fix or disable the source
changes.text: In place of editing: Fix the source, and Disable the source, which stops new runs and says the evidence will stop renewing. Turning it back on is one click.
changes.drata: To change test evidence you fix or disable the test, never the evidence.

changes.title: Past renewal names the run
changes.text: "Past renewal by 35 days: Audit log collection's last run was Sep 13" with Run the import now, which adds a fixed version dated today.
changes.drata: Needs renewal: past its renewal date, it hurts readiness until renewed.

changes.title: A rejected run is Error
changes.text: An automated item whose last run was rejected reads Error and counts neither way; the register names how many and its record says Fix the source.
changes.drata: Error: its test erred, so the evidence counts neither way.

current.note: A checklist is its own page under Evidence's STIG kind: no renewal date, no evidence status, no controls it evidences

changes.title: A checklist is fixed evidence
changes.text: Each STIG checklist is evidence from its source: every import is a fixed version, with no delete, and the record offers Fix or disable the source.
changes.drata: Evidence pulled from a connection is read-only and versioned; it is fixed at the source.

changes.title: Its open rules on the record
changes.text: The record lists the open rules by CAT (2 · 21 · 6 for RHEL 9), the first five with a link to all, and Results: rules, not a finding, not applicable, not reviewed, compliance.
changes.drata: Evidence a test produced shows what the test found beside the artifact.

changes.title: Renewal is the next import
changes.text: The renewal date is the next import V3 schedules (RHEL 9: Jan 11, 2027; the switch: Nov 16, past due). A run of its source on the sources screens renews it.
changes.drata: Evidence from a connection renews with each sync.

changes.title: The controls it evidences
changes.text: Its linked controls are its source's (CM-6, CM-7, CM-2, IA-5, AU-12 and their enhancements in the baseline), each a code chip with its status, cited by its rules.
changes.drata: Evidence shows the controls it maps to, each with its readiness.

pairs.title: Evidence picker on an assessment objective

current.note: Add evidence lists all 368 artifacts, any date, any state; nothing ties it to the campaign's period

changes.title: Only what is current in the period
changes.text: Opened from AC-17(04)(a)[01] of the expanded control set assessment (Sep 14 – Nov 20): it offers evidence collected in that window, not sent back and not lapsed.
changes.drata: Choose evidence offers only Ready or Upcoming renewal items for the audit period.

changes.title: What is hidden, and Show them
changes.text: "166 items hidden: not current in the assessment period. Show them." Shown, each says why (collected before the period, sent back, no artifact) and can't be linked.
changes.drata: One dated after the audit's end goes to the comment only, not the request.

changes.title: The pick maps to the control
changes.text: Linking maps each artifact to AC-17(4), the objective's control; the evidence register then counts it among that artifact's controls.
changes.drata: Map control, limited to the request's controls, in the same dialog.

changes.title: What serves the control first
changes.text: "Serves AC-17(4)" leads (here: nothing current, 2 out of the period), then other current evidence nearest first: AC-17, then AC.
changes.drata: The request page lists its evidence beside the controls it maps.

pairs.title: Import an SCTM or a POA&M spreadsheet

current.note: The SCTM lives in the workbook today; nothing imports a sheet

changes.title: Five steps, one at a time
changes.text: A full page with a vertical stepper: Upload, Map columns, Map values, Review, Confirm. Upload offers the sample, WS-X90 SCTM.xlsx, and SCTM or POA&M.
changes.drata: Bulk import: upload, map fields, map values, a sheet, then a confirmation.

changes.title: Columns mapped with a preview
changes.text: Each of the sheet's eight columns matched to a field by name (Control code, Requirement, Implementation status, Component, Owner…), with its first values and a three-row preview.
changes.drata: Map fields: incoming columns to destination fields, with a data preview.

changes.title: The sheet's words become ours
changes.text: Implemented, Partial, Planned, Not implemented and N/A map to WS-X90's implementation statuses; N/A rows are skipped unless mapped.
changes.drata: Map values: the sheet's values to destination values, such as Asset Type.

changes.title: Red blocks, amber updates
changes.text: 24 real WS-X90 rows; red cells (AU-6(40) and SC-7(52) not in the baseline, two empty owners) keep Next disabled and are fixed in place; amber cells say which implementation changes.
changes.drata: Red cells are errors and keep Submit disabled; yellow cells warn the row updates an existing item.

changes.title: Counts before it runs
changes.text: Created 6, updated 2, no change 14 and skipped 2 (locked), Moving 8 · Not moving 16; all or nothing; it says the prototype saves nothing.
changes.drata: A confirmation counts what will be created and updated before Import runs.

current.note: POA&M items are created one at a time under Findings; nothing imports a POA&M sheet

changes.title: The POA&M's own columns
changes.text: Map columns lists a POA&M sheet's headers (item ID, weakness, security control number, milestones, scheduled completion, status, POC, severity) with WS-X90's first three items as their values and the preview.
changes.drata: Bulk import maps each incoming column to a destination field, with a preview.

changes.title: Its status words become ours
changes.text: Ongoing, Completed, Risk Accepted and Not Applicable map to WS-X90's POA&M statuses; Not Applicable rows are skipped unless mapped.
changes.drata: Value mapping turns the sheet's words into the product's options.

changes.title: Red blocks, amber updates
changes.text: 21 of WS-X90's POA&M items and three open CAT I STIG rules not on it yet: unknown control codes and missing completion dates are red; a changed status or date is amber.
changes.drata: Invalid cells are red and block Submit; a yellow cell updates a record that exists.

changes.title: Counts before it runs
changes.text: Confirm counts the POA&M items it creates and updates, and the rows it leaves alone, before Import.
changes.drata: The confirmation states the create and update counts.

derived: Assessment frequency per control: the prototype holds none; WS-X90's parameters RA-05_ODP[01], CM-08_ODP[02] and CA-07_ODP[02] exist and are not set. Default: RA-5, SI-2, SI-3, SI-7, CM-6, CM-8 every 30 days; AU-6, SI-4, CA-7, AC-6 at least quarterly; every other control at least annually.
Renewal date = collected date + the shortest frequency among the evidence's controls (annual when it has none); an automated item renews at its source's 30-day import cadence.
Upcoming renewal window: within 60 days of the renewal date, or within a third of a shorter period (30 days for quarterly, 10 for monthly).

Lifecycle: Needs artifact when nothing is collected (66 requirement citations with no artifact) or the reviewer sent it back (To revise); Error when an automated item's last run was sent back; else Needs renewal / Upcoming renewal / Ready by the renewal date against Nov 17, 2026.
Source from the artifact's kind: Scan result → Scan import; Dataset → Link; a title naming an approval, exceptions, worksheet or manifest → Ticket; else File; no artifact → none.
Automated source name from the title: a monitoring log extract → Audit log collection; firmware, integrity or scan → ACAS vulnerability scan.
An automated item's earlier versions: one run every 30 days back from its collection, at most four, none before Jul 1, 2026.
Control readiness: a control is ready when its V3 status is Satisfied.
Picker period: the expanded control set assessment's window, Sep 14 – Nov 20, 2026 (PA.data.CAMPAIGNS). Current = collected inside it, not sent back, renewal date after it opened.

Import sample: 24 of WS-X90's controls (the first two of each of twelve families), each with its first mapping requirement, a component and owner; four cells broken on purpose; a row whose status differs from the SSP's updates it, a placeholder narrative is created, N/A is skipped.

STIG checklists as evidence: V3's seven checklists, read as V3's evidence register reads them (the old STIG register's rows and each checklist's preview); renewal date = the next import V3 schedules; a finished run of its source on lane C's screens renews it; its controls are its source's (lane C).

POA&M sample: 21 of WS-X90's open POA&M items that name a weakness and a control, each with a team member as POC (the items record none); three new rows from the RHEL 9 and Windows 11 checklists' open CAT I rules (CM-6, due 30 days after import); one row each Completed, Risk Accepted and Not Applicable; every fifth date 60 days later; four cells wrong on purpose.
PA.drB.renewalCheck counts evidence with an artifact (not an automated item in error): failing = past renewal or inside its upcoming window. 56 of 297 at reset (V3's own test says 54).
conflicts: Drata's green Ready met the prototype's rule that a status word has one tone everywhere: Ready is a neutral word there, so it stays grey and only the two problem words carry colour.
Drata's pale red Needs artifact banner met 'no tinted banners': the record's one next step (K.next) on a white card says it, with the button.
Drata's left filter panel met the one-row toolbar: Status, Source, Owner and Control family are filters in K.toolbar with saved views; the tiles set the Status filter.
Drata's five evidence states met four stat tiles and calm: Error has no tile and no rows by default (it counts neither way); one line over the table names it in warning words, with Show them.
Drata's row Update button and red Fix Now met 'Leave behind': rows carry no buttons; the record holds Add new artifact or Renew.
Drata's import is a near-full-screen modal; here it is a page with the kit's vertical stepper, so the steps are in the address and the menu stays.
